project.title: Workflow change: additional approval on a live workflow

sources.title: Change request: add an approval to the live workflow without losing evidence from open cases (chat request, 2026-09-21)
sources.summary: One-sentence request received in chat. The affected workflow, the current design (YAML or manifest), the position and owner of the new approval, the open-incident export and the list of affected fields, forms and integrations were not supplied. Country not stated: Angola recorded as provisional starting context.

sections.title: Request as received
sections.summary: Plan a new version with an extra approval without losing evidence from open cases.

sections.title: Context not supplied
sections.summary: Live design, open incidents, affected fields/forms/integrations, approver, position in the sequence, effective date.

decisions.question: Which workflow is being changed? Provide its Provia name (and id if known) and the current design: the live YAML export, or the packaged workflow.yaml and provia-project.json from the original implementation.
Where does the extra approval sit: after which existing action and before which? Is it a new Decision action, or an extra outcome on an existing decision?

Who approves (which group), what are the named outcomes (for example Approve / Reject / Return), where does Reject go (cancel the case or return to an action), and is a comment mandatory on Reject and Return?

Do open cases finish on the version they started (default, no evidence at risk) or must they also receive the extra approval? If they must, confirm the out-of-band route: the approver records the decision as a comment plus attached approval on the existing case, instead of cancelling and re-opening it.

Does the new version add, rename, remove or make required any case field, or change a Form Fill definition or intake form? Any such change must be listed before the open-incident impact check can close.

Supply the open-incident evidence (Provia export of incidents not yet closed on this workflow, with their current action and the fields they hold values in) or authorize the Provia connector so it can be read. Until then the active-incident impact check is pending.
Effective date of the new version and who communicates it to requesters, current assignees and the new approver group.
Confirm the country of operation and the response language for the customer-facing artefacts. Angola / English are provisional.
